summary.tldr: Authorizes $8.8 billion for federal public service expenses in 2022-23.
what_it_does: Authorizes $8,795,403,218 to be paid from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for public service expenses not otherwise provided for in the 2022-23 fiscal year.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 7 June 2022 and received Royal Assent on 23 June 2022.
